name: iSee Pro - Image Browser
summary: iSee Pro is a small Mac App Store image browser that loads all images of a folder and its subfolders with prefetching for fast paging. It has list, thumbnail and full-size views, name/size/date search, EXIF overlay, a magnifier and opens ZIP/RAR archives, remembering their passwords. Requires macOS 12.
where_it_wins: Very cheap ($0.99 Pro) and tiny (4.4 MB)
Search by image dimensions and Draw Things parameters
where_schnellbild_wins: Plays videos (iSee Pro needs a separate app)
Free and open source, notarized and attested
20 interface languages, light/dark setting, custom shortcuts
